observation_indicators.observable_fil: Kumpleto ang limang bahagi ng checklist; natutukoy ang unsafe task na ihihinto at supervisor na kokontakin; kasama ang heat, route at return-time plan.
observation_indicators.observable_en: Completes the five checklist fields, identifies the unsafe task to pause and supervisor to contact, and includes heat, route and return-time planning.
observation_indicators.not_yet_fil: Itinutuloy ang mapanganib na ruta o gawaing kulang ang proteksyon para lang matapos ang target.
observation_indicators.not_yet_en: Continues an unsafe route or unprotected task simply to finish the target.

levels.kaya_na_fil: Kumpleto ang limang bahagi ng checklist; natutukoy ang unsafe task na ihihinto at supervisor na kokontakin; kasama ang heat, route at return-time plan. Nagagawa kahit hindi pinapaalalahanan.
levels.kaya_na_en: Completes the five checklist fields, identifies the unsafe task to pause and supervisor to contact, and includes heat, route and return-time planning. Completes this without prompting.
levels.kailangan_practice_fil: May supplies at ruta ngunit kulang ang contact o pause condition; ipapunan bago muling magbrief.
levels.kailangan_practice_en: Lists supplies and route but misses a contact or pause condition; complete these before repeating the briefing.
levels.hindi_pa_fil: Itinutuloy ang mapanganib na ruta o gawaing kulang ang proteksyon para lang matapos ang target.
levels.hindi_pa_en: Continues an unsafe route or unprotected task simply to finish the target.
